reviews.text: Third time in this shop and never again. On every visit I’ve experienced an overly pushy sell. It’s also pretty overpriced to begin with.
Staff was so lovely and helpful when finding the right sized harness for our chihuahua! Thank you so much!

Thank you so much for your 5 star review. We truly enjoy caring for your pets while you’re away. It’s always a pleasure to look after them. We are looking forward to seeing their little furry faces again soon!

Probably the best and most friendly place to leave your pets. We have left our guinea pigs there on two occasions already and each time we get the best services possible. The staff is amazing and super friendly. One of the guinea pigs got ill just before we leave it to them and the Fur Family Pets staff has been in touch every day with updates. They took the ill one to the vets and got him treated. Honestly what a service. THANK YOU MILLIONS!!
Amazing service as well as super friendly staff. We left our pers there for a week and we took them in fantastic shape and well looked after. Thank you
Fantastic help from Helena with early days setting up home for a new puppy.

This is a lovely shop, with a friendly owner who has a great knowledge of pet care and just loves animals! She puts so much care into her pet boarding, home visits, and dog walking, giving the animals plenty of fuss, as well as feeding them. She looks after cats, dogs, rabbits, birds, rats, and guinea pigs, and she treats them with as much care as her own pets. Her prices are also very reasonable. She stocks a brilliant variety of items for pets, including food, beds, toys, and much more. Your pets will be in very capable hands at this shop, and I can't recommend her services highly enough.

We continue to take our guinea pigs here for boarding...
There  looked after there so well.
Lovely staff..
Clean kennels for animals..
And great little pet shop to buy goods.
Recommended.

The best pet shop in the area!! I’ve been bringing my rabbit pip, in for the last year or so for her nails and bum ,always does the best job. Staff are very welcoming and provide updates on your animal via WhatsApp ,definitely recommend ❤️❤️

Thank you for your 5 star rating. We look forward to seeing you and your Spaniel in the shop again soon and Helena is happy to home board him again any time you need 💛🐾

So happy I found this place in a budgie group. This was my first time leaving Hulk and Angel with someone other then close family so was worried  how they would cope.

Well I needn't not worried we received an update with a lovey picture letting us know they was absolutely fine. Collected them this morning and they was bouncy chirpy and looked fantastic.

Me and my husband have both agreed fur family will now be our go to when we go on holiday for sure.

Once again thank you so much would highly recommend 😊

Amazing pet shop and pet sitter for my rabbit.  My rabbit always comes back looking better than when I take it in!! Also they regularly give it rubs and lots of attention, including sending WhatsApp updates when I'm on holiday.

Highly highly recommend!!
